_comment: Signatures for diagnostics that follow the OCP Test and Validation Output Specification v2.0. They match the normalized *.ocptv.log files written by --ocp_diag (common/ocptv.py), one artifact per line: '[OCPTV] <OUTCOME> artifact=<type> <state fields> run=... step=... <details> seq=... ts=...'. Descriptions start with the severity (FAIL: / WARN:). Whitelist individual findings by verdict=, symptom= or name= values.

error_signatures.description: FAIL: OCP test run result FAIL
FAIL: OCP run or step ended with status ERROR
error_signatures.comment: The diagnostic itself did not complete (testRunEnd/testStepEnd status ERROR).
One line per failing verdict and hardware component.
Software or execution error reported by the diagnostic (error.symptom).
Measurement or measurement-series element that violates its validators, evaluated by log_analyzer even when the diagnostic emitted no diagnosis.
Fragments of the diagnostic output that are not valid JSON (truncated or corrupted output).
Log artifacts with severity ERROR. A run can still report PASS while logging these.

error_signatures.description: WARN: OCP diagnosis UNKNOWN or skipped run/step
error_signatures.comment: Inconclusive diagnosis, or a run/step that was skipped or not applicable.

error_signatures.description: FAIL: OCP test run did not finish
error_signatures.comment: Every complete run ends with testRunEnd. A missing one means the diagnostic crashed, hung or its output was truncated.
